text: President Trump sent the internet into stitches after he caught one media hack trying to bring back the most infamous ‘fashion’ statement from 2020. As TGP readers know, one could not walk into a store or restaurant in 2020 or 2021 without seeing hordes of people wearing face masks. The theory behind wearing face diapers is the objects would keep individuals from catching COVID-19. However, face masks proved to be utterly ineffective in stopping transmission. The virus is small enough to squeeze through even the most effective masks, N95s. Thankfully, America and the world returned to normalcy, and face masks eventually faded away. Or so we all thought. When a reporter attempted to ask Trump a question during a White House press conference on Wednesday, Trump noticed she was wearing a FACE MASK. Did she forget that the COVID pandemic ended about four years ago? Understanding this, Trump stopped the reporter mid-sentence to hilariously troll her for putting on a face diaper in 2025. “On handing education control to the states, how would you handle a state like California if it were to…” the reporter began. “You know, I haven’t seen a mask in sooo long!” Trump interrupted. “You’re wearing a mask, so nice of you!” “I haven’t seen anybody wearing a mask in a long time,” he continued. “It’s good. You feel more comfortable, right? “Yes,” the reporter meekly replied. LOL! WATCH: “You are wearing a mask! It’s so nice of you. I haven’t seen anybody wearing a mask in a long time. It is good.
